tolerance_authority.source: PUB-P2E14 candidate-blind common-domain Reference threshold surface
tolerance_authority.use: reference-stability scale only; not retuned from RossFast outcomes

purpose: Construct a stricter candidate-blind numerical Reference for the later equal-error cost experiment without inspecting timing or new RossFast configurations.

case_selection.rule: Use the six original SQ material identities already fixed in the publication experiment design, crossed with all three qualified common Se anchors and both retained forcing classes.
case_selection.note: This is a prospectively frozen performance/reference subset, not an untouched solver-accuracy holdout. Selection is independent of runtime or speed outcomes.

common_request.physics: same fixed solver-seam prescribed-flux E0 domain as P2E10/P2E15

stability_rule.rationale: Cap numerical-reference endpoint uncertainty at one tenth of the already frozen candidate-independent common-domain admission envelope.
stability_rule.storage_resolution_exception: P2E14 storage envelopes are already at floating-point summation scale. Multiplying them by 0.10 would demand sub-resolution agreement, so the exact P2E14 storage envelope is retained as the preregistered numerical-resolution floor.

outcome_policy.if_all_36_stable: Persist casewise REF-HIGH authority and permit a separately preregistered equal-error solver-control/timing experiment.
outcome_policy.if_any_unstable_or_invalid: Persist unresolved cases and restrict or block E3. Do not loosen stability criteria after observing the result.
